model_output.rationale: All four lines carry CO-22; MOA MA04 confirms primary payer adjudication data is absent. The 271 for the DOS shows EB*R with Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS as the primary payer ("PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER"). Claim was submitted to Delaware Valley Mutual with SBR*P (primary) — wrong order. Bill Medicare first, then rebill DVM secondary with Medicare's EOB data.

root_cause.explanation: 271 for DOS 2026-02-13 shows EB*R: Novitas Medicare Part B is primary. Claim was sent to Delaware Valley Mutual as primary (SBR*P/CI). CO-22 on all four lines; MOA MA04 flags missing primary adjudication data.

next_action.detail: Submit a new original claim (CLM05-3=1) to Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B (NPI 1846349352). After Medicare adjudicates, rebill Delaware Valley Mutual as secondary with Medicare's EOB/CAS data populated in the 2320/2430 loops.

evidence.fact: EB*R with Novitas Solutions Medicare Part B FFS; MSG: PLAN IS PRIMARY PAYER FOR THIS MEMBER; DTP*356 effective 2024-01-01 — Medicare primary on DOS 2026-02-13
SBR*P*18 with filing indicator CI — claim submitted to Delaware Valley Mutual as primary payer
CAS*CO*22 on all four service lines; MOA MA04 at claim level — COB order wrong, primary adjudication data absent
CARC 22 → resubmit_other_payer; bill the true primary then rebill this payer as secondary (06-cob-other-primary.md)

citations.rule: CARC 22 alone → resubmit_other_payer; cover exists, only order is wrong
